title: NBA Young Boy Dropping A Project In The Next 34 Days, Says Wack 100
htmlContent:
Last week, NBA Youngboy kicked off 2022 by dropping his brand new track, "Fish Scale."

He is also slated to drop a mixtape later this month called ''Emo Love,'' according to hiphop-n-more.com. Wack 100 was on Clubhouse Friday morning in the EarlyBirds & Allnighters room.

He shared that the album is supposed to drop in the next 34 days.

Last month, Wack 100 revealed that a single between Tekashi 6ix9ine and NBA Young boy is on the way; they are just waiting to get things cleared.

"It's' already done," said Wack 100. 6ix9ine's' European tour is done; his radio promo is already worked out. Yo, this is me. Business is business."

Following Young Boy's appearance on Clubhouse with DJ Akademiks, he shared a song with Tekashi 6ix9ine.

“I’ll do a song with 6ix9ine before I do a song with half of these pussy ass n***as, ya hear me?” he said to which Akademiks replied, “The industry gon’ kill you for that.”

“I ain’t got sh*t — I ain’t got nothin’ against him. That sh*t ain’t gon nun to do with me. I wasn’t in his situation. Half of these p***y ass n***as that be talkin’ don’t know what they’d do if they were in his situation. What the f**k that got to do with me or anybody else?”
